cards.t: South Korean Exchanges Halt CYBER Transfers Amid Solana Bridge Exploit
cards.b: South Korean exchanges halted CYBER transfers after unexpected minting of tokens on Solana and subsequent movement out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, alongside a $3.7 million exploit draining Fusionist's ACE bridge reserves.

per.CYBER: Transfers halted on South Korean exchanges due to unexpected token minting and bridge exploit fears.
per.ACE: Bridge reserves drained in a $3.7 million exploit.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total financial loss for CYBER and perpetrator identity.

cards.t: Upbit, Bithumb, and Coinone Add CYBER to Delisting Watchlist
cards.b: South Korean exchanges Upbit, Bithumb, and Coinone have added the CYBER token to their delisting watchlist following bridge exploit fears.

per.CYBER: Added to exchange delisting watchlists due to bridge exploit concerns.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
